§6Thermonuclear Bomb§f

§aFusion-boosted fission. The big one.§f
The §bThermonuclear Bomb§f is a two-stage weapon: a fission primary triggers a fusion secondary. It produces a much larger explosion than a standard nuclear bomb and generates unique byproducts.

Crafted with §bFusor Cores§f, §bFusion Fuel§f, and a fission primary stage. The detonation sequence is more complex than a standard bomb and requires careful wiring.

§cWARNING:§f This will generate massive amounts of lag! The explosion is enormous. Test in a dedicated void world if possible.

§ePS:§f The Thermonuclear Bomb is more of an endgame curiosity than a practical tool. But it's satisfying to watch from a safe distance.
